name: 30344 · East Point, GA
findings: ZIP 30344 (East Point) has 191 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 66 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30344 (East Point) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30344 (East Point) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 66 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
